description: Server content webviews (children of window 'main'). Users can add arbitrary LabHub servers, so the remote url grant cannot enumerate origins: URLPattern 'https://*' / 'http://*' match any http(s) origin (hostname wildcard; empty pathname auto-widens to '*'). Exposure is still contained: the navigation guard in webviews.rs only ever loads user-configured server origins in these webviews, and this capability deliberately grants ONLY desktop-notify plus a scoped opener open-url - never core:default or config commands. The opener grant is scoped to http/https URLs only (mirrors the plugin's own allow-default-urls glob semantics) so remote pages cannot reveal files in directories (allow-reveal-item-in-dir was dropped from the former opener:default grant) or open arbitrary schemes. core:event was dropped entirely: the notify shim needs only core.invoke, and event emit/listen would let any lab page spoof server-badge:// events at the rail. mailto:/tel: links from content pages still work through the shell's Rust-side on_new_window opener route, which bypasses the IPC ACL. 'windows' matches the parent window label, which covers every child webview (spike S5).
